note: One-shot sounds a kinetic film cues on its beats. Prompts are starting points for any sound-effects generator the user has; supplied or licensed libraries work the same way. Keep each sound short (every generated second costs) and isolated; record source and terms in the asset ledger.
negative: music, melody, speech, voice, crowd, long reverb, background noise

sounds.name: whoosh
sounds.prompt: a quick airy whoosh passing the camera once, clean and dry

sounds.name: whoosh_big
sounds.cue: zoom through a letter, a big section change
sounds.prompt: a heavy cinematic whoosh with a sub-bass swell, one pass

sounds.name: impact
sounds.prompt: a tight punchy impact with a short low tail, single hit

sounds.name: impact_big
sounds.prompt: a huge trailer boom with a metallic edge and a long tail, single hit

sounds.name: hit
sounds.prompt: a very short snappy hit, a crack layered with a snare

sounds.name: slash
sounds.prompt: one fast metallic swipe through the air

sounds.name: key
sounds.prompt: a single mechanical key press, close and dry

sounds.name: riser
sounds.prompt: a reverse cymbal swell rising in pitch and volume, ending with a sharp cut

sounds.name: glitch
sounds.prompt: a short burst of digital stutter

sounds.name: logo_hit
sounds.cue: the end card, where the music stops
sounds.prompt: a deep logo hit, a sub boom with a long shimmering tail

custom: Add one or more sounds for the film's own joke or world (a footstep, a door knock, a bell); a sound that belongs to the story is worth more than another generic impact.
